title: Petzl TIKKINA headlamp — ANSI/PLATO FL 1 lighting performance
claims: The Tikkina is rated 300 lumens under the ANSI/PLATO FL 1 protocol, weighs 92 g, has a wide beam and IPX4 weather resistance, and runs on three AAA/LR03 batteries (included) or an optional CORE rechargeable battery; alkaline, lithium or Ni-MH cells are compatible.
With three AAA/LR03 batteries: MAX BURN TIME 7 lm / 10 m / 100 h; STANDARD 100 lm / 40 m / 10 h; MAX POWER 300 lm / 65 m / 2.5 h, with 20 h reserve lighting on the higher modes.
With the CORE rechargeable battery: MAX BURN TIME 7 lm / 120 h; STANDARD 100 lm / 7 h; MAX POWER 300 lm / 3 h.
